usage: agentware relate [-h] [--format {text,json}] (--supersedes TARGET_ID |
                        --depends-on TARGET_ID | --blocks TARGET_ID |
                        --relates-to TARGET_ID)
                        subject

positional arguments:
  subject               id of the entry that GAINS the edge

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --format {text,json}  output format (default: text)
  --supersedes TARGET_ID
                        declare SUBJECT supersedes TARGET — the high-precision
                        declared trust signal recall consumes
  --depends-on TARGET_ID
                        declare SUBJECT depends-on TARGET
  --blocks TARGET_ID    declare SUBJECT blocks TARGET
  --relates-to TARGET_ID
                        declare SUBJECT relates-to TARGET
